text: Hamare mohalle ki main sadak par bade gadde hain, bike se roz log gir rahe hain
english_summary: Large potholes on the main road are causing daily bike accidents.

text: Pani ki supply 4 din se band hai, tanker bhi nahi aa raha
english_summary: No water supply for 4 days and no tanker is coming.

text: Primary health centre mein doctor hafte mein sirf 2 din aate hain
english_summary: The primary health centre has a doctor only 2 days a week.

text: Street lights kharab hain, raat ko chori ka darr rehta hai
english_summary: Broken street lights make the area feel unsafe at night.

text: School ki chhat se barish mein paani tapakta hai, bachche bheeg jate hain
english_summary: The school roof leaks in the rain and children get wet.

text: Naali ka gandaa paani sadak par beh raha hai, machhar aur bimari phail rahi hai
english_summary: Sewage is overflowing onto the road and spreading disease.

text: Kooda 10 din se uthaya nahi gaya, badbu se rehna mushkil hai
english_summary: Garbage has not been collected for 10 days.

text: Gaon mein bijli din mein sirf 5 ghante aati hai, kisan pump nahi chala paate
english_summary: Only 5 hours of electricity a day; farmers cannot run pumps.

text: Bus stop par shed nahi hai, garmi aur barish mein bahut takleef hoti hai
english_summary: The bus stop has no shelter from heat and rain.

text: Suggestion: gaon mein ek library aur computer centre khola jaye yuvaon ke liye
english_summary: Suggestion: open a library and computer centre for youth.

text: Hospital mein dawaiyan khatam hain, mareezon ko bahar se kharidni padti hai
english_summary: Hospital has run out of medicines; patients buy them outside.

text: Nadi kinare ka pul toot gaya hai, bachche school nahi ja paa rahe
english_summary: A broken bridge is stopping children from reaching school.

text: Bijli ka taar neeche latak raha hai, kabhi bhi haadsa ho sakta hai
english_summary: A low-hanging live wire is a serious accident risk.

text: Suggestion: sadak kinare ped lagaye jayen aur park banaya jaye
english_summary: Suggestion: plant trees along the road and build a park.

text: Hand pump kharab hai, poore tole mein sirf ek hi chalu hai
english_summary: Only one working hand pump serves the whole locality.
